title: ui: Console 退出登录 drops the provider-logout redirect that better-auth's sign-out answers, so single logout to the cloud never happens (cloud#3313 ui half)
body:
Filing gate ④: the `ui/` child of a cross-repo coordination card, objectstack-ai/cloud#3313 (single logout phase 1, environment → cloud), under the maintainer ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#3312 (comment 6435518659, letter A, 「同意」). The cloud dispatch order for #3313 says: "If the console sign-out in objectstack ui/ must change, file that half upstream … No cloud workaround."

**Business reason:** on a hosted environment, 退出登录 ends only the environment session. The cloud session stays, so 「使用 ObjectOS Cloud 继续」 signs the next person on a shared device straight back in as the previous one, with no password (cloud#3312 P5). The server side of the fix is in place; the Console is the last hop that drops it. Same gap for any self-hosted deployment that wires an OIDC provider through `oidcProviders` and wants its sign-out to end the IdP session.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat, one PR in `ui/packages/auth`. No spec or `/meta` change.

## Measured (cloud PR head on cloud#3313, framework pin `6390fe52`, local stack, real Chromium)

- better-auth 1.7.12's own `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-out` already does RP-initiated logout for an account linked through a `genericOAuth` provider (`better-auth/dist/api/routes/sign-out.mjs`): it ends the local session, then answers `{ success: true, url: <OP end_session_endpoint>?id_token_hint=…, redirect: true }`. With a body `callbackURL`, it adds `post_logout_redirect_uri` (= `callbackURL` resolved against the auth base URL) and `client_id`.
- The Console ignores that answer. `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` builds the better-auth client with `disableDefaultFetchPlugins: true` (which also drops better-auth's `redirectPlugin`), and its `signOut()` reads only `error`: `const { error } = await betterAuth.signOut(); TokenStorage.clear(); …`. The file already honours `{ url, redirect }` itself for `signIn.social` (the comment at the `signInSocial` block says why); sign-out has no such step, and sends no `callbackURL`.
- With the cloud half applied (the environment's client registered with `enable_end_session` and `post_logout_redirect_uris: [<env origin>/_console/login]`), following the URL works end to end: the OP ends the cloud session and redirects to `<env origin>/_console/login`; 「使用 ObjectOS Cloud 继续」 then lands on the cloud sign-in page. Without following it (today's Console), the cloud session survives and P5 reproduces.

## Wanted

1. `createAuthClient.signOut()` sends `callbackURL` = the Console's own sign-in page (`<basename>/login`, i.e. `/_console/login` on a hosted environment), and when the answer carries `redirect: true` with an `http(s)` `url`, navigates the window there (`window.location.assign`) after clearing `TokenStorage`, the way `signIn.social` is followed.
2. `AuthProvider.signOut()` keeps its purge (`purgeSignedOutClientCaches`, state reset) before the navigation; the remediation overlay's `SignOutLink` and the header's 退出登录 both go through it, so both follow.
3. No answer change for a deployment without a provider: better-auth answers `{ success: true }` alone, and the Console stays on its in-app route to the login page as today.

## Acceptance

- A unit test on `createAuthClient` (or `AuthProvider`): a sign-out answer with `{ redirect: true, url }` navigates to `url` and sends `callbackURL`; an answer without it does not navigate.
- The cloud side then needs a framework pin move; cloud#3313's staging read (P5 no longer reproduces) runs after it.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#3313 (cloud half: client registration + ADR-0024 amendment), objectstack-ai/cloud#3312 (decision), objectstack-ai/cloud#3314 (phase 2, cloud → environment).

Dedupe: objectstack issues "console sign-out follow provider logout redirect end_session callbackURL" → 0 hits; "signOut redirect RP-initiated logout OIDC provider" → 2 hits (#21885 closed docs on `/sign-in/oauth2`, #21849 closed Link Social Account), neither this.
